White House Bars CNN from Air Force One Trip

The White House barred CNN from traveling with President Donald Trump on Air Force One for his trip to Tennessee. CNN was scheduled to fly with the president as part of the White House press pool, which represents major TV networks. Real America's Voice News, a conservative network, reportedly replaced CNN on the trip. The ban occurred amid an ongoing fight over press access, with some US TV networks resuming White House pool coverage as this situation unfolded.
